notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
The new version 1.2 is now live!
The new update includes major bug fixes.
Here is the full changelog.


Fixed a bug where the game would crash at the last level.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
The new version 1.1 is now live!
The new update includes major bug fixes and 10 new achievement.
Here is the full changelog.

Fixed a bug where the level didn't end after losing all the balls.
Fixed a bug where the powerups persisted between levels.
Added sound effect for picking up powerups.
Added a way cancel shooting the ball (right click).
Added 10 achievements.
